# Day 26: Filter already-land candidate indices(lat, lon) out of calculation 
	+ Pre-compute spherical points once rather than inside hot loop

Date: 2026-03-03
Goal: Optimise rasterise function to trim compute time.

🔧 Technical Wins:
• Previously I did: for idx in candidate_indices:
			if landmask_flat[idx]:
				continue
  Instead do: candidate_indices = candidate_indices[~landmask_flat[candidate_indices]]
• Also, previously inside the inner loop I had points = [pygplates.PointOnSphere(...)] which creates a C++ object for each loop.
  Instead, have point = [pygplates.PointOnSphere(lat, lon) for lat, lon in zip(flat_lats, flat_lons)] at grid creation before loop, 
  then inside the loop we only nned to run the test if poly.is_point_in_polygon(points[idx]): which is computationally cheap.

🪛 Next (for museum demo purposes):

				"trex":68,
				"triceratops":70,
